ledger: 00:18: White ceramic mug on counter contains light brown liquid (coffee with cream), fill level high/near full.
00:22: Glass carafe pours black coffee into white ceramic mug.
00:38: Man holds white ceramic mug containing dark coffee.

findings.description: At 00:18, the mug is shown full of light-colored liquid. At 00:22, black coffee is poured into the mug as if it were empty or lower. The light liquid disappears without a visible removal action, and adding more liquid to a full container would cause overflow.
